posts.name: Mirudhula B
posts.cooked:
My specific doubt is on the topic:

My doubt is: Need help accessing next term’s courses in IIT Madras BS degree after registration and payment?

Recommended:
Mention what you have done till now to find clarification on the doubt:

Hello everyone
I’m having doubts in iit madras bs degree
First of all I Recently finished my first term exam of foundational degree (1st step of bs)
I have registered and paid fees for next term but I don’t know how to access the new term course
Did you know how to solve this?
Is you also facing the same problem when you are in second term of foundational degree in iit madras

posts.name: Adri Sarkar
posts.cooked: This term will start on 19th Sep, you’ll be able to access your course contents from then. Kindly wait till then. Also on the IITM DS website under the academics section you’ll find the academic calendar, do follow that to stay updated.

posts.name: Anirban Mandal
posts.cooked:
As @adrisarkar said. It starts from tomorrow.

For this type doubts always check the Academic Calendar
